facts.fact: Hanoi is the capital, on the Red River, with historic architecture, lakes and an Old Quarter shaped by crafts and trades.
facts.excerpt: A captivating capital city nestled on the banks of the Red River, Hanoi seamlessly blends thousands of years of rich history with a dynamic modern energy.
facts.location: Visible official page text; corresponding named visitor-information or destination section

facts.fact: The Old Quarter is traditionally associated with 36 streets and specific trades; the page also identifies tube houses and narrow alleys.
facts.excerpt: The Old Quarter: A bustling maze of 36 historic streets, each traditionally dedicated to specific crafts and trades.
facts.location: Visible official page text; corresponding named visitor-information or destination section

facts.fact: Hoan Kiem includes the red Huc Bridge and a lakeside promenade.
facts.excerpt: Hoan Kiem Lake & Ngoc Son Temple: The symbolic heart of the city, featuring the iconic red Huc Bridge and a peaceful lakeside promenade.
facts.location: Visible official page text; corresponding named visitor-information or destination section

facts.fact: The tourism authority describes cool drizzly winters and hot humid summers.
facts.excerpt: Cool, drizzly winters, hot and humid summers, and short, pleasant springs and autumns.
facts.location: Visible official page text; corresponding named visitor-information or destination section

facts.fact: Noi Bai is the city airport; buses, taxis and ride-hailing are listed as transfer options.
facts.excerpt: About 45 km from the centre by airport bus, taxi or ride-hailing, with the Reunification Express linking the city to Hue and Ho Chi Minh City.
